gameTravel.title: Trail
gameTravel.intro: Travel from the start figure to the destination by stepping through connections. You can move to anyone who shares a book or belongs to the same group. Arrive within the move budget to succeed.
gameTravel.mobileRuleSummary: Pick a neighbor to move one step → reach the destination to win
gameTravel.fixtureMode: ⚠ Demo Mode — running on sample data

rules.connectBody: Move between figures who share the same book or belong to the same group. Each step shows why they are connected.
rules.budgetBody: Arrive within the budget to succeed. You don't need to find the shortest path. You can keep going over budget, but your score drops.
rules.scoreBody: Arrive within budget for a high score. Each extra step costs points. Giving up scores zero.
